'''Illusia''' is an NPC in found within [[Depths of Illusive Realm]] and helps provide Rover with "Dreams", in the form of Tokens and Echoes, to navigate the Somnoire. It is later implied Illusia is not a single person, but multiple dreamers drawn from the Somnoire.<ref>[[When the Night Knocks]]</ref>

"She" has not made many appearance as of late, and is been replaced by [[Dorothy]] for unknown reasons. However, the Gatekeepers and Namipon refer to or see Dorothy as the [[Illusia]]<ref>[[Depths of Illusive Realm: Chromatic Fantasy]].</ref>
